add.title: Register a switch
add.description: Use a verified wire identity and profile. The suffix is not an output count. Then open pairing separately. {outcome}

pair.title: Targeted pairing
pair.description: Register the device first. A zero duration closes pairing. Acceptance opens the window; pairing completes only after a valid device report. {outcome}

refresh.title: Refresh state
refresh.description: Runs one bounded read-only query. A timeout does not prove the device is offline. {outcome}

forget.title: Forget device
forget.description: Removes the daemon record, not the physical device pairing. Its HA entities become unavailable and can then be removed. {outcome}

discover.title: Detect a switch · Experimental
discover.description: Put only the intended new switch into physical pairing mode, with pairing on the original EC gateway disabled. Observed unregistered devices: {count}. Select an ID to review its profile. Submit without selecting a device to refresh the list. Unknown, conflicting or expired profiles require fresh evidence or manual setup. Older daemons may support only manual setup.

detected.title: Review detected switch · Experimental
detected.description: Device: **{device}**. Detected outputs: **{outputs}**. Wire suffix: **{suffix}**. Check the physical button count and enter a name. This experimental detection recognizes the tested one- and two-gang pairing signatures only. Submit to register this profile. Registration does not complete physical pairing: afterwards, reopen Configure → Targeted pairing for this device once the radio is ready. Evidence must still be fresh when submitted; otherwise select the switch again.

firmware_preflight.title: Firmware preflight
firmware_preflight.description:
Board: **{board}**. Installed: **{installed}**. Candidate: **{target}**.

Compatible: **{compatible}**. Ready to request installation: **{executable}**. Blocking reason: **{reason}**.

{checks}

This check does not flash, restart or send radio commands. It uses the daemon’s current identity evidence and revalidates the local firmware package. Results are advisory; installation checks again. To install, use the gateway’s Firmware update entity after closing this report. Submit to close, or select Refresh to check again.

pair_new.title: Pair new device
pair_new.description: Submit to open one two-minute pairing session. Then put only the intended new switch into its physical pairing mode. The daemon detects its supported profile, registers it and waits for a fresh pairing confirmation. No wire ID or output count is required. Existing devices are retained. The gateway also has Pair new device and Cancel pairing buttons, with live Pairing status. {detail}

pairing_status.title: Pairing session
pairing_status.description:
Status: **{status}**. {explanation}

Session: {session}. Remaining: {remaining} seconds. Device: **{device}**. Outputs: **{outputs}**. Registered: **{registered}**.

Reason: {reason}. Observations: {observations}.

Registration is not pairing confirmation. Submit to refresh an active session or select Stop to close it. Submit after a terminal result to close this report. Closing this dialog does not stop the daemon session; it expires automatically. The gateway Pairing status updates live.

error.detection_unavailable: This switch has no fresh, unambiguous supported profile. Put it into pairing mode and refresh, or use manual setup.
error.detection_changed: The reviewed profile expired, changed, was registered elsewhere, or the radio is unavailable. Refresh and select the switch again.
error.detection_failed: Registration was rejected or could not be confirmed. Check the daemon registry before retrying. Refresh and select again if it was not added; pairing has not been opened.
error.radio_not_ready: The radio is not ready. Wait for it to reconnect before detecting a switch.
error.preflight_unsupported: Update the Livolo daemon to a release that supports firmware preflight. Switch control remains available.
error.commissioning_unsupported: Update the Livolo daemon to enable automatic pairing. Advanced manual setup remains available.
error.commissioning_failed: The pairing action or result could not be confirmed. Check Pairing status before starting again; no automatic retry is performed.

firmware_offer_withdrawn.title: Firmware update offer is no longer available
firmware_offer_withdrawn.description:
The previous radio firmware update offer ({offered_version}) for **{gateway}** is no longer available because the configured catalog is missing, unusable, or has no compatible image. **This does not confirm a firmware installation.**

Last reported installed version: **{installed_version}**. Open the gateway device and inspect **Radio firmware status** under Diagnostic for the reported version and last job result. Restore or select the reviewed firmware catalog, then use **Configure → Check firmware update (read-only)**. This notice does not install firmware or retry a job. It clears when a compatible catalog returns or firmware job status takes precedence.
